name: wan-formal
purpose: Predeclared video serving protocol; GPU capability and standalone calibration are checked before running.
sweep_protocol: Run each named sweep independently over the same five paired seeds. Vary one factor at a time; do not cross rates, CVs, SLOs and shapes globally. Replay is a separate collection-timestamp experiment requiring its own source hash and time scale.
quality_protocol: VBench official full-set evaluation is separate from the serving test-prompt workload. Per-request reference metrics do not substitute for the official score.
